note: What the Code editor template (Quaderno) does, checked headless: affrescoui test code-editor.scenarios.json

scenarios.name: open-files-from-the-tree
scenarios.note: A file row of the explorer tree opens the file in a new tab; a folder row opens or closes the folder

steps.note: README.md, at the root (the open files above it grew by one)

scenarios.name: unsaved-tab-asks-before-closing
scenarios.note: Typing marks the file unsaved; Cmd+W asks first, and Don't save closes it and drops the change

scenarios.name: save-from-the-close-dialog
scenarios.note: Save in the close dialog keeps the change, then closes the tab

scenarios.name: saving-updates-the-problems
scenarios.note: The problems come from the saved files: fixing the FIXME and saving leaves no error

scenarios.name: a-large-file
scenarios.note: Calibration.cpp is generated on load: 5,000 lines, with a TODO every 1,000 lines

steps.note: the end of the file on every platform (Super+Down is macOS only)

scenarios.name: a-problem-opens-its-file
scenarios.note: Choosing a row of the problems table opens the file it is in

steps.note: the panel is hidden at first, as in the editor it models

scenarios.name: quick-open
scenarios.note: Cmd+P lists every file; typing filters them and Enter opens the first match

scenarios.name: find-panel
scenarios.note: Cmd+F opens the find panel at the bottom; typing counts the matches, Enter goes to the next, Escape closes it

scenarios.name: find-replace-all
scenarios.note: Cmd+Alt+F opens find with replace; Replace All changes every match in the file

scenarios.name: word-wrap
scenarios.note: Alt+Cmd+W turns word wrap on and off

scenarios.name: command-palette
scenarios.note: Cmd+Shift+P lists every command; running one hides the explorer, and another shows the about dialog

scenarios.name: menus
scenarios.note: The menu bar opens a menu of commands; New file adds an unsaved file and opens it

scenarios.name: run-terminal-commands
scenarios.note: Ctrl+` shows and focuses the terminal; help prints the commands, an unknown one says so, and clear empties it

scenarios.name: undo-an-edit
scenarios.note: Cmd+Z in the editor brings back the text that typing replaced

scenarios.name: goto-line
scenarios.note: Ctrl+G opens Goto Anything at ':'; a line number and Enter put the caret on that line

scenarios.name: goto-symbol
scenarios.note: Cmd+R lists the file's symbols after '@'; choosing one goes to its line

scenarios.name: search-in-the-file
scenarios.note: '#' in Goto Anything lists the lines holding a text; choosing one selects it there

scenarios.name: goto-a-symbol-in-another-file
scenarios.note: A file name before '@' in Goto Anything lists that file's symbols; choosing one opens the file there

scenarios.name: goto-a-line-in-another-file
scenarios.note: A file name before ':' and a number open that file at that line

scenarios.name: goto-symbol-in-project
scenarios.note: Cmd+Shift+R lists the symbols of every file; choosing one opens its file at its line

scenarios.name: find-in-files
scenarios.note: Cmd+Shift+F searches the project into a Find Results buffer; F4 goes to each match in turn, a double click to the one under the caret

scenarios.name: find-in-some-folders
scenarios.note: 'Where' narrows Find in Files to the paths holding one of its comma-separated parts

scenarios.name: the-assistant-opens
scenarios.note: Tools > Assistant (or Cmd+Shift+A) opens the chat add-on's panel; Escape closes it

scenarios.name: replace-in-files
scenarios.note: Find in Files' Replace lists the matches, then replaces them in the files 'Where' names, which become unsaved

scenarios.name: line-operations
scenarios.note: Duplicate, delete and move the caret's line up, each with its key

scenarios.name: toggle-comment
scenarios.note: Cmd+/ comments the caret's line out with the file's line comment, and back

scenarios.name: convert-case
scenarios.note: Upper case, from the command palette, acts on the word at the caret

scenarios.name: reopen-a-closed-file
scenarios.note: Cmd+Shift+T brings back the last file closed, at the end of the tabs

scenarios.name: revert-a-file
scenarios.note: Revert File drops the unsaved changes

scenarios.name: close-all-files
scenarios.note: Close All Files closes the saved files, then asks about an unsaved one
